answer: Split-tally stops farms merging fakes: the pool splits into 8 lagoon shards, each identity dealt to one. A 70-credit jade bond locks it in; a receipt valid in one lagoon is void in the rest. Three auditors run a prism test: key, log, timestamp must match, or the bond burns. Each filing costs 45, so 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 plus 70,000 bonded against a 40,000 pool. A rented receipt fails and burns; honest agents file once, pay 45, keep their share.
